name: mailflat-mcp
description: MCP server that gives an agent its own email inbox: it opens the inbox, waits for the one-time code a signup sends, and reads or sends mail. Addresses are permanent, so a test suite does not need a new one per run; only the messages expire, on a retention window you set.
